newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo has first earnings rise of 1996 in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Akzo has first earnings rise of 1996 in Q3.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV noted on Wednesday that the third quarter of 1996 was the first quarter of this year in which it achieved a higher operating profit and net income versus the year-ago period.
Third quarter net income edged up to 328 million guilders from 324 million while operating profit rose to 510 million guilders from 494 million.

Akzo Nobel said third-quarter turnover rose five percent to 5.49 billion guilders, with positive exchange rate effects contributing three percentage points of the rise and higher sales volumes two percentage points.
Third-quarter selling prices were on average at the same level as in the third quarter of 1995, it added.
The three percent rise in third-quarter operating profit was almost entirely due to the coatings business, where operating profit rose to 201 million guilders from 146 million.
Chemicals and fibres both posted lower operating profits while pharmaceuticals' operating profit rose only marginally.
